data.description:
## Context / Problem
With `rebar.reconciler` a real package (previous story), the shadow-package bridge, canonical-root guard, and key-seeding conftests are dead weight that still runs on every test, and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` keeps the retired name alive. The test-side loader complex is: `tests/_engine_path.py` (canonical-root helper: `engine_dir`, `acli_path`, `is_canonical_key`, `engine_root_of`, `foreign_engine_registrations`, `repo_root`), `tests/conftest.py:462-505` (`_one_engine_root` autouse), `tests/unit/conftest.py:22-97` (shadow-package bridge), `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py:39-95`, `tests/unit/test_engine_root_convention.py`, `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_load_module_identity.py`, and `tests/_log_integrity.py:54` (`SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES` includes `rebar_reconciler`). 17 test files import `_engine_path` (`git grep -l _engine_path origin/main -- tests`). `pyproject.toml:691-698` has `testpaths=["tests"]` and no `pythonpath`/`rootdir`, so the package rename needs no pytest config change. `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` has 29 `autouse_fixture::tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/...` keys; a path move makes every one `new` and `make lint` fails. Cites are on origin/main 083620b0.

## Approach
1. Delete `tests/_engine_path.py`: its engine functions (`engine_dir`, `acli_path`, `is_canonical_key`, `engine_root_of`, `foreign_engine_registrations`) go with no replacement, the 17 importers are re-pointed, and the `repo_root()` callers fold onto `tests/_repo_root.py`.
2. Delete `tests/conftest.py:462-505` (`_one_engine_root`), the `tests/unit/conftest.py:22-97` shadow bridge (keep the session-log fixture), and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/conftest.py:39-95` (keep the two autouse env fixtures). Delete `tests/unit/test_engine_root_convention.py` and `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_load_module_identity.py`.
3. `tests/_log_integrity.py:54`: `SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES` becomes `("rebar",)`; update `tests/unit/test_caplog_coverage_integrity.py` to match.
4. `git mv tests/unit/rebar_reconciler tests/unit/reconciler` and `git mv tests/integration/rebar_reconciler tests/integration/reconciler`; update `scripts/check_docs_index.py:43` and the docs that name the test path (`docs/coverage.md`, `docs/code-navigation.md`).
5. `.github/mechanism-baseline.json`: re-spell the 29 `autouse_fixture::tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/...` keys to `autouse_fixture::tests/unit/reconciler/...` with counts unchanged (operator-sanctioned maintenance edit, recorded on the epic and restated in the commit message). Do the re-spell first; then, because the deleted autouse fixtures and the deleted `tests/_engine_path.py` helper are censused mechanisms and `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py:357-364` asserts the committed baseline equals the live tree, run `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale` (it refuses to write while anything is `new`) and commit the baseline in the same change (itemised in this ticket's comments).

## Scope
`tests/_engine_path.py` (deleted), `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/unit/conftest.py`, `tests/unit/reconciler/**` (renamed), `tests/integration/reconciler/**` (renamed), `tests/_log_integrity.py`, `tests/unit/test_caplog_coverage_integrity.py`, `tests/unit/test_engine_root_convention.py` (deleted), `tests/unit/reconciler/diffing/test_load_module_identity.py` (deleted), `scripts/check_docs_index.py`, `.github/mechanism-baseline.json`, `docs/coverage.md`, `docs/code-navigation.md`. Out of scope: every `src/` file, the pytest configuration in `pyproject.toml` (no change needed), and the behaviour of any test beyond how it locates the engine.

## Testing
Happy: `pytest tests/unit/reconciler -q -n 4 --dist worksteal` and `make test`. Edge: `pytest --co -q | grep -c rebar_reconciler` is 0; `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` prints `new=0`; a non-editable install lane (`uv pip install .` then `pytest tests/unit/reconciler/apply -q`) passes — the dual-copy hazard that bug `ethnic-rubber-shoveler` (`bd2d-3e31-31d9-4a66`) guarded is gone because tests import the installed package like every other `rebar.*` test.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No `tests/**/rebar_reconciler` directory; no `_one_engine_root`, `_bridge_reconciler_shadow_package`, `_seed_dotted_namespace` symbol — `git ls-tree` and `git grep`.
- [ ] `tests/_engine_path.py` is absent and `git grep -n _engine_path -- tests` is empty.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0; `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` prints `new=0`.
- [ ] `tests/_log_integrity.SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES == ("rebar",)` — `tests/unit/test_caplog_coverage_integrity.py` updated and green.
data.title: Delete the test-side engine-root machinery and rename tests/unit/rebar_reconciler to tests/unit/reconciler
